## Generated documents

These are rebuilt from the repository by the tool named, and CI fails if the committed copy is stale. They are the only documents that must never be edited by hand.

| Document | Regenerate with |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/PROGRESSION.md` | `python3 tools/build_progression_doc.py` |
| `docs/CONTROL_SIZES.md` | `python3 tools/control_size_report.py` |
| `docs/DATA_COMPLETENESS.md` | `python3 tools/report_data_completeness.py` |
| `docs/DATA_QUALITY.md` | `python3 tools/build_world_atlas.py --report` |
| `docs/COUNTRY_CODES_AND_REGIONS.md` | `python3 tools/build_country_codes.py` |
| `docs/STATISTICS_REPORT.md` | `python3 tools/build_statistics.py --report` |
| `docs/CURRENCY_REPORT.md` | `python3 tools/build_currency.py --report` |
| `docs/INDEX.md` | `python3 tools/build_docs_index.py` |
